What I checked:
- CI on 3da36b5 is green (lint, typecheck, test, build). Vercel preview is ready.
- Test-first: `test(recorder): add seeded mutation fuzz test (#4)` (327cefe) adds `src/mutation-fuzz.test.ts` only. Then `fix(recorder): order same-batch adds so nextId exists (#4)` (3da36b5) fixes the bug the fuzz test found.
- The fuzz test uses mulberry32 with fixed seeds 1, 7, 42, 99 and 256, 200 operations each. No `Math.random`, no timers. I ran it locally: 5 tests pass in about 1.3 seconds, well under the 5 second limit.
- The bug and its fix are listed in the PR note and explained in ADR 0024. `docs/decisions/README.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` are updated.
- Two older assertions in `observers/mutation.test.ts` were changed in the fix commit. I compared them: they still use exact `toEqual` with the same parent and `nextId` links, only the array order changed. This is not a weaker test. Process note: AGENTS.md asks for such test updates in a separate `test: fix <what> (#4)` commit. I am not asking to rewrite history; please follow the rule next time.

All 5 parts are done. The final code review follows in a separate review.
